name: Chunk 18/33

raw_entities.name: Operational Risk Policy
raw_entities.description: A formal policy governing the identification, assessment, and management of operational risks within the organisation. This policy establishes the framework for managing risks arising from inadequate or failed internal processes, people, systems, or external events.

raw_entities.name: Risk Appetite Statement
raw_entities.description: A formal statement defining the organisation's risk appetite and tolerance levels across risk categories for 2026. This document establishes the boundaries within which the bank is willing to operate and the thresholds for escalation and governance oversight.

raw_entities.name: Anti-Money Laundering Policy
raw_entities.description: A formal policy establishing the bank's framework for detecting, preventing, and reporting money laundering and terrorist financing activities. This policy defines AML screening procedures, transaction monitoring requirements, and reporting obligations to relevant authorities.
